title: Lowell Foods
description: Lowell International Foods is an importer and distributor of Polish and other European foods, headquartered in Franklin Park, Illinois. The company offers a wide range of products including preserves, dairy, meats, traditional Polish dishes, and specialty items from various European countries. With a focus on quality, Lowell collaborates with producers to create items that meet high standards and uses the finest raw materials. Their products are available for purchase through their Amazon store and are aimed at both consumers and retailers looking to offer premium European cuisine
